title: x-unraid
description: Presentation metadata carried inside an ordinary compose file. Validates the x-unraid blocks and permits every other compose key, so it can be run against a whole compose file converted to JSON. Validate the SOURCE file converted to JSON, not `docker compose config` output, which has a history of stripping extension fields.

version.description: Schema version. A reader seeing a higher major version falls back to inference rather than misreading the metadata.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the stack directory name.

icon.description: URL, or a path relative to the stack directory.

category.description: Unraid's existing category taxonomy, e.g. MediaApp:Video.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the service key.

webui.description: Link to the container's web interface. Supports Unraid's [IP] and [PORT:nnnn] substitution; [PORT:nnnn] resolves the HOST port currently mapped to container port nnnn, so the link survives a port change.

display.description: 'advanced' hides the entire service behind the form's advanced toggle — for sidecars such as databases.

fields.description: Form fields, in display order. Anything in the service not claimed by an entry here is still inferred and appended.

field.description: Binds presentation metadata to one thing in the service. Exactly one binder key. Unknown keys are permitted and ignored, matching runtime behaviour, so this schema does not catch typos in attribute names.

port.description: CONTAINER port, optionally with protocol: 8096 or '1900/udp'. Never the host port — that is what the user edits.

device.description: CONTAINER path of the device. Where the compose entry names only one path, host and container are the same.

setting.description: A scalar service key. Restricted in v1 to keys where a form control is meaningful; anything else is edited as YAML.

title.description: Human name for the field. Called 'title' rather than 'label' because 'label' is a binder here, mirroring the compose key it binds to. Inferred from the target when omitted.

required.description: Blocks save when empty. Never inferred — a wrongly guessed requirement blocks a save the user cannot resolve.

mask.description: Password input; redacted in logs and exports. Inferred from the variable name when omitted.

type.description: Input control. Inferred from the binder when omitted.

mode.description: Mount mode. Applies to 'volume' bindings only.

group.description: Section heading. Consecutive fields sharing a group render together.
